description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `promiseAll(promises)` koja radi kao `Promise.all`, bez njegove upotrebe.

- vraća promise koji se razrešava nizom rezultata, **istim redosledom** kao ulaz
- ulaz može sadržati i obične vrednosti, ne samo promise-e
- prazan niz se razrešava praznim nizom
- čim jedan promise bude odbijen, rezultat se odbija istom greškom
description.en:
Write a function `promiseAll(promises)` that works like `Promise.all`, without using it.

- returns a promise that resolves to an array of results in the **same order** as the input
- the input may contain plain values, not only promises
- an empty array resolves to an empty array
- as soon as one promise is rejected, the result is rejected with the same error

note.sr: Rezultat se upisuje na indeks `i`, a ne sa `push`, jer promise-i ne moraju da se razreše redom.
note.en: The result is stored at index `i` instead of using `push`, because promises do not have to resolve in order.
